label: Text-to-Image — Qwen-Image (non-anime studio base)
description: Qwen-Image txt2img pipeline: UNETLoader → CLIPLoader(qwen_image) + VAELoader → ModelSamplingAuraFlow(shift) → EmptySD3LatentImage → KSampler(euler/simple) → VAEDecode → SaveImage. The studio's verified NON-ANIME base (Apache-2.0). Selected by project/pack defaults.base = "qwen-image".

placeholders.NEGATIVE_PROMPT: Negative prompt text (always include anime/cartoon/cel-shading terms — non-anime is non-negotiable)
placeholders.CLIP: Text encoder filename (default qwen_2.5_vl_7b_fp8_scaled.safetensors, loaded with type=qwen_image)

notes: Built programmatically — the JSON above is a reference. lib/adapters/comfyui-workflows.js buildQwenGraph() constructs the live graph; buildWorkflowGraph() and scripts/generate.js both route to it when base === 'qwen-image'. Node ids/wiring mirror scripts/qwen_generate.py for cross-runner reproducibility. NEVER substitute an anime checkpoint (Illustrious/Pony/Animagine/NoobAI) — see memory/feedback_no_anime.md.
